review_comment: Landlord identity supported by contract. Full testimony also cited, but does not make it an independent proof source.
Tenant identity supported by contract. This identity node improperly also summarizes move-out and replacement/lease claims.
Both lease dates and monthly rent 3000 now appear, but are inside the same contract-rules node allocated to U008. Not missing content; merge-blocked independent background/amount use.
Contractually agreed deposit 2000 now appears, distinct from actual transfer in unit 3, but is not an independent node because contract unit 2 already matches U008.
Both normal-expiry/no-breach full refund and early-termination no refund now explicit. Combining these two rules is appropriate; additional bundling of lease/rent/deposit is reviewed separately.
Date, payer, payee, amount and deposit note supported by transfer text transcription; this is not independent verification of original banking evidence.
February 25 possible departure due to work change explicit. Other party conditional proposal shares same communication node; one match only.
Conditional negotiation proposal explicit in unit 6, but same node allocated to U012. Omission of vague March 1 reply is not penalized.
Already-found friend explicit in units 1/5, allocated to U002/U027. Unit 6 only says willingness to help, not already found. March 1 chat detail omitted, not replaced by willingness.

March 5 chat explicitly conveys refusal due to early termination. Overall stance also appears in unit 8; do not score it twice. This choice leaves unit 8 available for its explicit several-day vacancy claim.

Self-reported March 5 move-out supported by Zhang testimony. Cleaning/no damage can remain useful handover attributes; event/action classification incorrectly reifies testimony, but coverage is separate.

The model-generated timeline explicitly says Zhang claims March 8 move-in, with a valid Zhang-testimony quote. Its unrelated contract quote is invalid: the entire batch is rejected, and this is diagnostic content credit only. No node was split or repaired.

Later separate lease explicit in original content; assigned to this existing node, with move-in assigned to existing timeline node 10. This allocation does not mean finding/move-in/signing were cleanly separated. Title/summary wrongly suggest March 8 signing.

No-loss assessment explicit, but same unit primarily titled deposit-remedy stance and allocated to U030. Still a harmful merge; changing the allocation would swap the credited Gold without adding coverage.
Do-not-deduct-all remedy explicit as primary stance. Also bundles no-loss assessment, so no second Gold credit.

Several-day vacancy explicit in Li testimony; March 5 current vacancy also appears in unit 7. Both temporal scopes may be combined; still not integrated into one useful vacancy node. This content match is separate from ideal node organization.
Loss assertion explicit but unit 8 allocated to U035. Lack of an independently addressable loss claim impairs comparison with the tenant loss assessment.
